accuracy.name: accuracy
accuracy.definition: right answers, counting a right report of absence, over all rollouts

graded_accuracy.name: graded_accuracy
graded_accuracy.definition: right answers with partial credit, counting a right report of absence, over all rollouts

false_confidence_rate.name: false_confidence_rate
false_confidence_rate.definition: rollouts that asserted a wrong answer, meeting none of its answer key or missing a condition the key declared required, over all rollouts. An answer that fell short only by saying nothing is not one of these

interval.method: Wilson score interval on a proportion

partially_correct_rate.name: partially_correct_rate
partially_correct_rate.definition: rollouts that asserted an answer meeting part of its answer key, over all rollouts

interval.method: Wilson score interval on a proportion

recall.name: recall
recall.definition: rollouts that found the right value, over rollouts of examples where a value exists
recall.population: rollouts of examples where a value exists

abstention_rate.name: abstention_rate
abstention_rate.definition: rollouts that reported absence, over all rollouts

failure_rate.name: failure_rate
failure_rate.definition: rollouts that produced no answer at all, over all rollouts

interval.method: Wilson score interval on a proportion

precision_when_asserting.name: precision_when_asserting
precision_when_asserting.definition: rollouts that asserted the right value, over rollouts that asserted anything

interval.method: Wilson score interval on a proportion
